import math

const real64 pi := 3.141592653589793

com64 conjugate(com64 value)
    return com64(value.real) - com64(value.imag) * com64(1.0i)

real64 magnitude(com64 value)
    result := math.sqrt(value.real * value.real + value.imag * value.imag)
    return result

com64 rot(real64 angle)
    cosine := math.cos(angle)
    sine := math.sin(angle)
    return com64(cosine) - com64(sine) * com64(1.0i)

int pow2(int value)
    result := 1
    while result < value
        result *= 2
    return result

com64[] zeros(int count)
    return [for j := (0:<int(count))[] then com64(0.0)]

com64[] complex_values(real64[] source, length := 0)
    count := if length == 0 then int(#source) else length
    result := zeros(count)
    for: j < int(#source)
        result[j] = com64(source[j])
    return result

com64[] radix2(com64[] source, inverse := false)
    count := int(#source)
    values := source
    bits := 0
    power := count
    while power > 1
        bits += 1
        power /= 2
    for: 1 <= index < count
        reversed := 0
        rest := index
        for: bit < bits
            reversed = reversed * 2 + rest % 2
            rest /= 2
        if index < reversed
            temporary := values[index]
            values[index] = values[reversed]
            values[reversed] = temporary
    com64[] twiddle := []
    for: k < count / 2
        factor := rot(2.0 * pi * real64(k) / real64(count))
        twiddle = twiddle.append(if inverse then conjugate(factor) else factor)
    size := 2
    while size <= count
        stride := count / size
        half := size / 2
        for: start < count step size
            for: j < half
                t := twiddle[j * stride] * values[start + j + half]
                u := values[start + j]
                values[start + j] = u + t
                values[start + j + half] = u - t
        size *= 2
    if inverse
        for &value := &values[]
            value /= com64(real64(count))
    return values

com64[] bluestein(com64[] values)
    count := int(#values)
    size := pow2(2 * count - 1)
    chirp := [for k := (0:<int(count))[] then rot(pi * real64((k * k) % (2 * count)) / real64(count))]
    a := zeros(size)
    b := zeros(size)
    for: k < count
        a[k] = values[k] * chirp[k]
        b[k] = conjugate(chirp[k])
        if k > 0
            b[size - k] = b[k]
    af := radix2(a)
    bf := radix2(b)
    product := [for k := (0:<int(size))[] then af[k] * bf[k]]
    convolved := radix2(product, true)
    return [for k := (0:<int(count))[] then chirp[k] * convolved[k]]

com64[] dft(com64[] values)
    return if pow2(int(#values)) == int(#values) then radix2(values) else bluestein(values)

com64[] idft(com64[] values)
    count := int(#values)
    if pow2(count) == count
        return radix2(values, true)
    conjugates := [for value := values[] then conjugate(value)]
    return [for value := bluestein(conjugates)[] then conjugate(value) / com64(real64(count))]

com64[] packed_real(real64[] values)
    count := int(#values)
    half := count / 2
    z := [for j := (0:<int(half))[] then com64(values[2 * j]) + com64(values[2 * j + 1]) * com64(1.0i)]
    transformed := radix2(z)
    com64[] result := []
    for: k <= half
        opposite := (half - k) % half
        if opposite < 0
            opposite += half
        a := transformed[k % half]
        b := conjugate(transformed[opposite])
        even := (a + b) / com64(2.0)
        odd := (a - b) / com64(2.0i)
        result = result.append(even + rot(2.0 * pi * real64(k) / real64(count)) * odd)
    return result

real64[] convolution(real64[] first, real64[] second)
    count := int(#first) + int(#second) - 1
    size := pow2(count)
    af := radix2(complex_values(first, size))
    bf := radix2(complex_values(second, size))
    product := [for k := (0:<int(size))[] then af[k] * bf[k]]
    inverse := radix2(product, true)
    return [for j := (0:<int(count))[] then inverse[j].real]

com64[] chirp_z(real64[] values, int sample_rate, int low, int high, int points)
    count := int(#values)
    step := real64(high - low) / real64(points - 1)
    fs := real64(sample_rate)
    size := pow2(count + points - 1)
    a := zeros(size)
    b := zeros(size)
    for: n < count
        a[n] = com64(values[n]) * rot(2.0 * pi * real64(low) * real64(n) / fs) * rot(pi * step * real64(n) * real64(n) / fs)
    for: -(count - 1) <= offset < points
        index := if offset < 0 then offset + size else offset
        b[index] = conjugate(rot(pi * step * real64(offset) * real64(offset) / fs))
    af := radix2(a)
    bf := radix2(b)
    product := [for k := (0:<int(size))[] then af[k] * bf[k]]
    g := radix2(product, true)
    return [for j := (0:<int(points))[] then rot(pi * step * real64(j) * real64(j) / fs) * g[j]]

import math
import signal_io = "./signal_io.qui"
import fft = "./fft.qui"
import windows = "./windows.qui"
import spectral = "./spectral.qui"
import report = "./report.qui"

real64 absolute(real64 value)
    return if value < 0.0 then -value else value

int min_int(int first, int second)
    return if first < second then first else second

int max_int(int first, int second)
    return if first > second then first else second

real64 total(real64[] values)
    real64 result := 0.0
    for value := values[]
        result += value
    return result

real64 energy(real64[] values)
    real64 result := 0.0
    for value := values[]
        result += value * value
    return result

real64 rms(real64[] values)
    result := math.sqrt(energy(values) / real64(#values))
    return result

real64 db(real64 value, real64 factor := 20.0)
    logarithm := math.log(value)
    return factor * logarithm / 2.302585092994046

real64 arctangent(real64 value)
    invert := value > 1.0
    z := if invert then 1.0 / value else value
    reduce := z > 0.41421356237309503
    if reduce
        z = (z - 1.0) / (z + 1.0)
    squared := z * z
    power := z
    real64 result := 0.0
    for: j < 40
        result += power / real64(2 * j + 1)
        power *= -squared
    if reduce
        result += fft.pi / 4.0
    return if invert then fft.pi / 2.0 - result else result

real64 argument(com64 value)
    if value.real == 0.0 and value.imag == 0.0
        return 0.0
    if value.real == 0.0
        return if value.imag >= 0.0 then fft.pi / 2.0 else -fft.pi / 2.0
    ratio := value.imag / value.real
    result := arctangent(absolute(ratio))
    if ratio < 0.0
        result = -result
    if value.real < 0.0
        result += if value.imag >= 0.0 then fft.pi else -fft.pi
    return result

real64 phase(com64 value)
    return argument(value) * 180.0 / fft.pi

int maximum_index(real64[] values, int first, int last)
    best := first
    for: first + 1 <= j <= last
        if values[j] > values[best]
            best = j
    return best

int[] strongest(real64[] values, int limit)
    indices := [for j := (1:<int(int(#values) - 1))[] if spectral.local_maximum(values, j) then j]
    count := int(#indices)
    span := 1
    while span < count
        int[] merged := []
        for: start < count step 2 * span
            middle := min_int(count, start + span)
            finish := min_int(count, start + 2 * span)
            first := start
            second := middle
            while first < middle or second < finish
                take_first := second >= finish
                if first < middle and second < finish
                    a := indices[first]
                    b := indices[second]
                    take_first = values[a] > values[b] or (values[a] == values[b] and a < b)
                if take_first
                    merged = merged.append(indices[first])
                    first += 1
                else
                    merged = merged.append(indices[second])
                    second += 1
        indices = merged
        span *= 2
    int[] result := []
    for: j < min_int(limit, count)
        result = result.append(indices[j])
    return result

(real64[], real64[]) detrend(real64[] samples, int sample_rate)
    count := int(#samples)
    average := total(samples) / real64(count)
    center := real64(count - 1) / 2.0
    real64 numerator := 0.0
    real64 denominator := 0.0
    low := samples[0]
    high := samples[0]
    for: i < count
        offset := real64(i) - center
        numerator += offset * (samples[i] - average)
        denominator += offset * offset
        if samples[i] < low
            low = samples[i]
        if samples[i] > high
            high = samples[i]
    slope := numerator / denominator
    real64[] residual := []
    real64 peak := 0.0
    real64 third := 0.0
    real64 fourth := 0.0
    for: i < count
        value := samples[i] - average - slope * (real64(i) - center)
        residual = residual.append(value)
        if absolute(value) > peak
            peak = absolute(value)
        third += value ^ 3.0
        fourth += value ^ 4.0
    level := rms(residual)
    return (residual, [average, slope * real64(sample_rate), level, low, high, peak / level, (third / real64(count)) / (level ^ 3.0), (fourth / real64(count)) / (level ^ 4.0)])

real64 bandwidth(real64[] values, int index)
    real64 root_two := math.sqrt(real64(2.0))
    cutoff := values[index] / root_two
    real64 left := 0.0
    right := real64(int(#values) - 1)
    for: index + 1 <= j < int(#values)
        if values[j] <= cutoff
            right = real64(j - 1) + (values[j - 1] - cutoff) / (values[j - 1] - values[j])
            break
    j := index - 1
    while j >= 0
        if values[j] <= cutoff
            left = real64(j + 1) - (values[j + 1] - cutoff) / (values[j + 1] - values[j])
            break
        j -= 1
    return right - left

class Peak(int bin_index, real64 position, real64 amplitude, real64 frequency, real64 refined, real64 level_db, real64 phase_angle, real64 band_width, real64 snr, real64 coherence_value, string label)

(Peak[], real64, real64) analyze_peaks(real64[] amplitudes, com64[] transformed, signal_io.Params params, int sample_rate, spectral.Welch welch)
    length := params.main_length
    fs := real64(sample_rate)
    largest := amplitudes[maximum_index(amplitudes, 0, int(#amplitudes) - 1)]
    floor_value := spectral.median(amplitudes[1:<int(#amplitudes) - 1])
    Peak[] peaks := []
    for k := strongest(amplitudes, int(#amplitudes))[]
        if db(amplitudes[k] / largest) < params.peak_threshold or int(#peaks) >= params.peak_count
            continue
        fitted := spectral.interpolate(amplitudes, k)
        coherence_bin := (2 * k * params.welch_length + length) / (2 * length)
        peaks = peaks.append(Peak(k, fitted[0], fitted[1], real64(k) * fs / real64(length), fitted[0] * fs / real64(length), db(amplitudes[k] / largest), phase(transformed[k]), bandwidth(amplitudes, k) * fs / real64(length), db(amplitudes[k] / floor_value), welch.coherence[coherence_bin], "other"))
    for &peak := &peaks[]
        for: 1 <= h <= 10
            if absolute(peak.position - real64(h) * params.fundamental * real64(length) / fs) <= real64(params.search_width)
                peak.label = "h{h}"
                break
        if peak.label == "other"
            multiple := math.floor(peak.refined / real64(params.notch_frequency) + 0.5)
            if multiple >= 1 and absolute(peak.refined - real64(multiple * params.notch_frequency)) <= real64(params.notch_width)
                peak.label = "mains"
        if peak.label == "other"
            for: pivot < int(#peaks)
                middle := peaks[pivot]
                if middle.bin_index == peak.bin_index or amplitudes[middle.bin_index] <= amplitudes[peak.bin_index]
                    continue
                for other := peaks[]
                    if other.bin_index != peak.bin_index and other.bin_index != middle.bin_index and amplitudes[middle.bin_index] > amplitudes[other.bin_index] and absolute(peak.position + other.position - 2.0 * middle.position) <= 1.0
                        peak.label = "sideband{pivot + 1}"
                        break
                if peak.label != "other"
                    break
    return (peaks, largest, floor_value)

class FilterResult(real64[] bandpassed, real64[] notched, real64[] envelope, real64[] smoothed)
    kept := 0
    removed := 0
    real64 band_rms := 0.0
    real64 notch_rms := 0.0
    real64 band_ratio := 0.0
    real64 dc_gain := 0.0
    real64 fir_gain := 0.0
    real64 fir_rms := 0.0
    real64 fir_error := 0.0
    real64 envelope_mean := 0.0
    envelope_bin := 0
    real64 envelope_frequency := 0.0
    real64 envelope_amplitude := 0.0
    real64 envelope_depth := 0.0
    real64 instantaneous_mean := 0.0
    real64 instantaneous_std := 0.0

FilterResult analyze_filters(real64[] first, real64[] second, signal_io.Params params, int sample_rate)
    count := int(#first)
    fs := real64(sample_rate)
    transformed := fft.dft(fft.complex_values(first))
    band := fft.zeros(count)
    notch := fft.zeros(count)
    analytic_spectrum := fft.zeros(count)
    kept := 0
    removed := 0
    for: k < count
        frequency := min_int(k, count - k) * sample_rate
        if params.band_low * count <= frequency <= params.band_high * count
            band[k] = transformed[k]
            kept += 1
        multiple := (2 * frequency + params.notch_frequency * count) / (2 * params.notch_frequency * count)
        difference := frequency - multiple * params.notch_frequency * count
        if multiple >= 1 and (if difference < 0 then -difference else difference) <= params.notch_width * count
            removed += 1
        else
            notch[k] = transformed[k]
        if 1 <= k <= (count - 1) / 2 and params.envelope_low * count <= k * sample_rate <= params.envelope_high * count
            analytic_spectrum[k] = com64(2.0) * transformed[k]
    bp := fft.idft(band)
    nt := fft.idft(notch)
    analytic := fft.idft(analytic_spectrum)
    bandpassed := [for value := bp[] then value.real]
    notched := [for value := nt[] then value.real]
    envelope := [for value := analytic[] then fft.magnitude(value)]
    envelope_mean := total(envelope) / real64(count)
    centered := [for value := envelope[] then value - envelope_mean]
    envelope_transform := fft.dft(fft.complex_values(centered))
    modulation := [for value := envelope_transform[] then 2.0 * fft.magnitude(value) / real64(count)]
    envelope_bin := maximum_index(modulation, 1, ((params.envelope_high - params.envelope_low) * count) / (2 * sample_rate))
    fitted := spectral.interpolate(modulation, envelope_bin)
    real64[] instantaneous := []
    for: 1 <= i < count
        delta := argument(analytic[i]) - argument(analytic[i - 1])
        if delta <= -fft.pi
            delta += 2.0 * fft.pi
        if delta > fft.pi
            delta -= 2.0 * fft.pi
        instantaneous = instantaneous.append(delta * fs / (2.0 * fft.pi))
    frequency_mean := total(instantaneous) / real64(#instantaneous)
    real64 variance := 0.0
    for value := instantaneous[]
        variance += (value - frequency_mean) ^ 2.0
    smoothed := fft.convolution(second, params.fir)
    gain := com64(0.0)
    for: j < int(#params.fir)
        gain += com64(params.fir[j]) * fft.rot(2.0 * fft.pi * params.fundamental * real64(j) / fs)
    real64 fir_error := 0.0
    for: i < count + int(#params.fir) - 1
        real64 direct := 0.0
        for: max_int(0, i - int(#params.fir) + 1) <= j <= min_int(count - 1, i)
            direct += second[j] * params.fir[i - j]
        difference := absolute(smoothed[i] - direct)
        if difference > fir_error
            fir_error = difference
    result := FilterResult(bandpassed, notched, envelope, smoothed)
    result.kept = kept
    result.removed = removed
    result.band_rms = rms(bandpassed)
    result.notch_rms = rms(notched)
    result.band_ratio = energy(bandpassed) / energy(first)
    result.dc_gain = total(params.fir)
    result.fir_gain = db(fft.magnitude(gain))
    result.fir_rms = rms(smoothed[0:<count])
    result.fir_error = fir_error
    result.envelope_mean = envelope_mean
    result.envelope_bin = envelope_bin
    result.envelope_frequency = fitted[0] * fs / real64(count)
    result.envelope_amplitude = fitted[1]
    result.envelope_depth = fitted[1] / envelope_mean
    result.instantaneous_mean = frequency_mean
    result.instantaneous_std = math.sqrt(variance / real64(#instantaneous))
    return result

int wrapped(int index, int size)
    return if index < 0 then index + size else index % size

(int, real64) choose_lag(real64[] values, int limit)
    size := int(#values)
    best := -limit
    for: -limit <= lag <= limit
        value := values[wrapped(lag, size)]
        previous := values[wrapped(best, size)]
        magnitude := if lag < 0 then -lag else lag
        previous_magnitude := if best < 0 then -best else best
        if value > previous or (value == previous and (magnitude < previous_magnitude or (magnitude == previous_magnitude and lag < best)))
            best = lag
    neighborhood := [values[wrapped(best - 1, size)], values[wrapped(best, size)], values[wrapped(best + 1, size)]]
    fitted := spectral.interpolate(neighborhood, 1, false)
    return (best, real64(best) + fitted[0] - 1.0)

class Correlation(int lag, real64 refined, real64 delay, real64 coefficient, int phat_lag, real64 phat_refined, real64 phat_delay)

Correlation analyze_correlation(real64[] first, real64[] second, int limit, int sample_rate)
    size := fft.pow2(2 * int(#first) - 1)
    fx := fft.radix2(fft.complex_values(first, size))
    fy := fft.radix2(fft.complex_values(second, size))
    cross := [for k := (0:<int(size))[] then fft.conjugate(fx[k]) * fy[k]]
    phased := [for value := cross[] then value / com64(fft.magnitude(value))]
    raw := [for value := fft.radix2(cross, true)[] then value.real]
    phat := [for value := fft.radix2(phased, true)[] then value.real]
    lag, refined := choose_lag(raw, limit)
    phat_lag, phat_refined := choose_lag(phat, limit)
    scale := math.sqrt(energy(first) * energy(second))
    return Correlation(lag, refined, 1000.0 * refined / real64(sample_rate), raw[wrapped(lag, size)] / scale, phat_lag, phat_refined, 1000.0 * phat_refined / real64(sample_rate))

class Pitch(int lag_min, int lag_max, int hps_bin, real64 hps_frequency, int acf_lag, real64 period, real64 frequency, real64 strength, int crossings, real64 crossing_frequency)

Pitch analyze_pitch(real64[] amplitudes, real64[] bandpassed, signal_io.Params params, int sample_rate)
    length := params.main_length
    half := length / 2
    hps_bin := -1
    real64 hps_value := -inf
    for: 1 <= k <= half
        if not (params.pitch_low * length <= k * sample_rate <= params.pitch_high * length and 5 * k <= half)
            continue
        real64 value := 0.0
        for: 1 <= r <= 5
            logarithm := math.log(amplitudes[r * k])
            value += logarithm
        if value > hps_value
            hps_value = value
            hps_bin = k
    size := fft.pow2(2 * int(#bandpassed) - 1)
    transformed := fft.radix2(fft.complex_values(bandpassed, size))
    com64[] power := []
    for value := transformed[]
        magnitude := fft.magnitude(value)
        power = power.append(com64(magnitude * magnitude))
    acf := [for value := fft.radix2(power, true)[] then value.real]
    lag_min := (sample_rate + params.pitch_high - 1) / params.pitch_high
    lag_max := sample_rate / params.pitch_low
    lag := maximum_index(acf, lag_min, lag_max)
    fitted := spectral.interpolate(acf, lag, false)
    crossings := 0
    for: 1 <= i < int(#bandpassed)
        if bandpassed[i - 1] < 0.0 <= bandpassed[i]
            crossings += 1
    return Pitch(lag_min, lag_max, hps_bin, real64(hps_bin * sample_rate) / real64(length), lag, fitted[0], real64(sample_rate) / fitted[0], fitted[1] / acf[0], crossings, real64(crossings * sample_rate) / real64(#bandpassed))

int target_index(real64[] values, int length, real64 center, int width)
    best := -1
    for: 1 <= k < length / 2
        if absolute(real64(k) - center) <= real64(width) and (best < 0 or values[k] > values[best])
            best = k
    return best

class Harmonic(int bin_index, real64 position, real64 amplitude, real64 refined, real64 level_db)

string yes_no(bool value)
    return if value then "yes" else "no"

void run()
    data := signal_io.read_inputs()
    signal_io.Params params := data.params
    sample_rate := data.sample_rate
    fs := real64(sample_rate)
    count := int(#data.first)
    length := params.main_length
    half := length / 2
    first, first_stats := detrend(data.first, sample_rate)
    second, second_stats := detrend(data.second, sample_rate)
    weighted, transformed, amplitudes := spectral.amplitude(first, params.main_window, length)
    figures := windows.figures(windows.window(params.main_window, length), sample_rate)
    welch := spectral.welch(first, second, sample_rate, params.welch_length, params.welch_window)
    peaks, largest, floor_value := analyze_peaks(amplitudes, transformed, params, sample_rate, welch)
    Harmonic[] harmonics := []
    real64 harmonic_energy := 0.0
    for: 1 <= h <= 10
        center := real64(h) * params.fundamental * real64(length) / fs
        index := target_index(amplitudes, length, center, params.search_width)
        fitted := spectral.interpolate(amplitudes, index)
        harmonics = harmonics.append(Harmonic(index, fitted[0], fitted[1], fitted[0] * fs / real64(length), 0.0))
        if h > 1
            harmonic_energy += fitted[1] * fitted[1]
    primary := harmonics[0].amplitude
    for &harmonic := &harmonics[]
        harmonic.level_db = db(harmonic.amplitude / primary)
    root_harmonic := math.sqrt(harmonic_energy)
    thd := root_harmonic / primary
    real64[] power := [for k := (0:<(int(half) + 1))[] then 0.0]
    real64 sum_power := 0.0
    real64 first_power := 0.0
    real64 weighted_frequency := 0.0
    real64 log_power := 0.0
    for: 1 <= k < half
        real64 value := amplitudes[k] * amplitudes[k] / 2.0
        power[k] = value
        sum_power += value
        distance := k - harmonics[0].bin_index
        if (if distance < 0 then -distance else distance) <= params.search_width
            first_power += value
        weighted_frequency += (real64(k) * fs / real64(length)) * value
        logarithm := math.log(value)
        log_power += logarithm
    total_power := sum_power / figures[3]
    p1 := first_power / figures[3]
    thdn := math.sqrt((total_power - p1) / p1)
    centroid := weighted_frequency / sum_power
    real64 spread_sum := 0.0
    real64 cumulative := 0.0
    real64 rolloff := -1.0
    for: 1 <= k < half
        spread_sum += ((real64(k) * fs / real64(length) - centroid) ^ 2.0) * power[k]
        cumulative += power[k]
        if rolloff < 0.0 and cumulative >= 0.85 * sum_power
            rolloff = real64(k) * fs / real64(length)
    spread := math.sqrt(spread_sum / sum_power)
    geometric_mean := math.exp(log_power / real64(half - 1))
    flatness := db(geometric_mean / (sum_power / real64(half - 1)), 10.0)
    grid, frame_error := spectral.spectrogram(first, params.frame_length, params.hop, params.frame_window)
    real64 gmax := 0.0
    for row := grid[]
        for value := row[]
            if value > gmax
                gmax = value
    int[] dominant := []
    real64[] flux := [0.0]
    for: t < int(#grid)
        dominant = dominant.append(maximum_index(grid[t], 1, params.frame_length / 2 - 1))
        if t > 0
            real64 value := 0.0
            for: k < int(#grid[t])
                real64 difference := grid[t][k] - grid[t - 1][k]
                value += if difference > 0.0 then difference else 0.0
            flux = flux.append(value)

import math

string decimal(real64 value)
    absolute := if value < 0.0 then -value else value
    rounded := math.floor(absolute * 10000.0 + 0.5)
    sign := if value < 0.0 and rounded != 0 then "-" else ""
    tail := string(rounded % 10000)
    return sign + string(rounded / 10000) + "." + "0" * nat(4 - int(#tail)) + tail

void write_lines(string name, string[] rows)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(rows.join(NL) + NL)

void csv(string name, string header, string[][] rows)
    write_lines(name, [header].concat([for row := rows[] then row.join(",")]))

string[] shades(real64[][] grid, int sample_rate, int length, int band_db, real64 maximum)
    const levels := " .:-=+*#%@"
    string[] rows := []
    k := length / 2
    while k >= 0
        pixels := ""
        for frame := grid[]
            logarithm := math.log(frame[k] / maximum)
            d := 20.0 * logarithm / 2.302585092994046
            loss := math.floor(-d / real64(band_db))
            level := if 9 - loss < 0 then 0 else 9 - loss
            pixels += levels[level]
        frequency := decimal(real64(k * sample_rate) / real64(length))
        padding := if int(#frequency) < 9 then 9 - int(#frequency) else 0
        rows = rows.append(" " * nat(padding) + frequency + " |" + pixels + "|")
        k -= 1
    return rows

real64 number(string text)

    return result

import math
import fft = "./fft.qui"
import windows = "./windows.qui"

real64 median(real64[] values)
    ordered := values.sorted()
    middle := int(#ordered) / 2
    return if int(#ordered) % 2 == 1 then ordered[middle] else (ordered[middle - 1] + ordered[middle]) / 2.0

bool local_maximum(real64[] values, int index)
    return 0 < index < int(#values) - 1 and values[index] > values[index - 1] and values[index] > values[index + 1]

real64[] interpolate(real64[] values, int index, logarithmic := true)
    if not local_maximum(values, index)
        return [real64(index), values[index]]
    a := values[index - 1]
    b := values[index]
    c := values[index + 1]
    if logarithmic
        a = math.log(a)
        b = math.log(b)
        c = math.log(c)
    delta := (a - c) / (2.0 * (a - 2.0 * b + c))
    fitted := b - (a - c) * delta / 4.0
    if logarithmic
        fitted = math.exp(fitted)
    return [real64(index) + delta, fitted]

(real64[], com64[], real64[]) amplitude(real64[] signal, string name, int length)
    weights := windows.window(name, length)
    real64[] weighted := []
    real64 s1 := 0.0
    for: j < length
        weighted = weighted.append(signal[j] * weights[j])
        s1 += weights[j]
    transformed := fft.dft(fft.complex_values(weighted))
    real64[] amplitudes := []
    for: k <= length / 2
        real64 factor := if k == 0 or 2 * k == length then 1.0 else 2.0
        amplitudes = amplitudes.append(factor * fft.magnitude(transformed[k]) / s1)
    return (weighted, transformed, amplitudes)

(com64[], real64) packed_and_error(real64[] samples)
    packed := fft.packed_real(samples)
    reference := fft.radix2(fft.complex_values(samples))
    real64 error_value := 0.0
    for: k < int(#packed)
        difference := fft.magnitude(packed[k] - reference[k])
        if difference > error_value
            error_value = difference
    return (packed, error_value)

class Welch(int segments, real64[] psd, real64[] coherence, com64[] transfer, real64 packing_error)

Welch welch(real64[] first, real64[] second, int sample_rate, int length, string name)
    weights := windows.window(name, length)
    real64 energy := 0.0
    for value := weights[]
        energy += value * value
    segments := (int(#first) - length) / (length / 2) + 1
    count := length / 2 + 1
    real64[] pxx := [for k := (0:<int(count))[] then 0.0]
    pyy := pxx
    pxy := fft.zeros(count)
    real64 packing_error := 0.0
    for: block < segments
        start := block * (length / 2)
        a := [for j := (0:<int(length))[] then first[start + j] * weights[j]]
        b := [for j := (0:<int(length))[] then second[start + j] * weights[j]]
        af, ae := packed_and_error(a)
        bf, be := packed_and_error(b)
        if ae > packing_error
            packing_error = ae
        if be > packing_error
            packing_error = be
        for: k < count
            ax := fft.magnitude(af[k])
            ay := fft.magnitude(bf[k])
            pxx[k] += ax * ax
            pyy[k] += ay * ay
            pxy[k] += fft.conjugate(af[k]) * bf[k]
    real64[] psd := []
    real64[] coherence := []
    com64[] transfer := []
    for: k < count
        real64 factor := if k == 0 or k == length / 2 then 1.0 else 2.0
        magnitude := fft.magnitude(pxy[k])
        psd = psd.append(factor * pxx[k] / (real64(segments) * real64(sample_rate) * energy))
        coherence = coherence.append(magnitude * magnitude / (pxx[k] * pyy[k]))
        transfer = transfer.append(pxy[k] / com64(pxx[k]))
    return Welch(segments, psd, coherence, transfer, packing_error)

(real64[][], real64) spectrogram(real64[] signal, int length, int hop, string name)
    weights := windows.window(name, length)
    frames := (int(#signal) - length) / hop + 1
    real64[][] grid := []
    real64 maximum_error := 0.0
    for: frame < frames
        samples := [for j := (0:<int(length))[] then signal[frame * hop + j] * weights[j]]
        transformed, error_value := packed_and_error(samples)
        grid = grid.append([for value := transformed[] then fft.magnitude(value)])
        if error_value > maximum_error
            maximum_error = error_value
    return (grid, maximum_error)

import math
import fft = "./fft.qui"

string[] names()
    return ["rectangular", "hann", "hamming", "blackman", "flattop"]

real64[] coefficients(string name)
    if name == "rectangular"
        return [1.0]
    if name == "hann"
        return [0.5, 0.5]
    if name == "hamming"
        return [0.54, 0.46]
    if name == "blackman"
        return [0.42, 0.5, 0.08]
    return [0.21557895, 0.41663158, 0.277263158, 0.083578947, 0.006947368]

real64[] window(string name, int length)
    weights := coefficients(name)
    real64[] result := []
    for: n < length
        real64 total := 0.0
        for: j < int(#weights)
            real64 cosine := math.cos(2.0 * fft.pi * real64(j) * real64(n) / real64(length))
            real64 sign := if j % 2 == 0 then 1.0 else -1.0
            total += sign * weights[j] * cosine
        result = result.append(total)
    return result

real64[] figures(real64[] values, int sample_rate)
    real64 s1 := 0.0
    real64 s2 := 0.0
    scalloping := com64(0.0)
    for: n < int(#values)
        value := values[n]
        s1 += value
        s2 += value * value

    logarithm := math.log(fft.magnitude(scalloping) / s1)
    return [s1, s2, s1 / real64(#values), enbw, enbw * real64(sample_rate) / real64(#values), -20.0 * logarithm / 2.302585092994046]
